accepted.evidence: Turner 10016 lists Lahnda mā “mother” under mātŕ̥, exactly matching Grierson Khetrani mā. The etymon is the inherited kinship stem as classified by Turner, not a claim that nursery renewal can be excluded. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 6481 lists Lahnda dhī “daughter” under duhitŕ̥, exactly matching Grierson Khetrani dʰī and its kinship sense. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 3275 gives Lahnda kuttā masculine “dog” and feminine °tī under *kutta. Grierson Khetrani kuttā “Dog (male)” is an exact local match. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 3275 gives Lahnda kuttā masculine “dog” under *kutta. This second Grierson Khetrani kuttā is independently printed in the general Dog row. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 3275 lists the Lahnda feminine °tī beside kuttā under *kutta. Grierson Khetrani kuttī “Bitch” matches this feminine dog form. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 8082 lists Lahnda pāṇī “water” under pānī́ya. Grierson Khetrani pānī has the same water sense; its source n is retained without silent retroflexion. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
